## MCP - Quiz Generator

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/quiz-generator

**Parameters:**
- `data` (required): Text, topic or URL to generate quiz from
- `source` (optional): text | topic | url (default: text)
- `openai_api_key` (required): OpenAI API key
- `model` (optional): gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini (default: gpt-4o)
- `options.num_questions` (optional): Number of questions (default: 10)
- `options.question_types` (optional): [multiple_choice, true_false, fill_blank]
- `options.difficulty` (optional): easy | medium | hard (default: medium)
- `options.language` (optional): fr | en (default: fr)
- `options.include_explanations` (optional): boolean (default: true)
- `execution_mode` (optional): online | offline

**Returns:** Quiz with questions, answers, and explanations
